Total number of questions—20

Installed production capacity of
fertilizer plants
*181. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of fertilizer/urea plants
set up during the Ninth Five Year Plan
period and those proposed to be set up
during the Tenth Five Year Plan, State-wise
and location-wise;
(b) the installed production capacity of
each of the aforesaid units; and
(c) by when their commercial
production is expected to be started?
Integrated data base for forests
*182. SHRI ABANI ROY:
SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item caption
“Governments environment data five years
old”, published in the Times of India, dated
8th February, 2002;
(b) if so, whether the Committee on
Environment and Health recommended
creating an integrated data base tracking
trends and developing warning indicators;
(c) if so, whether Government have
contemplated any action on such
recommendations, so far; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Cost of laying rail line
*183. PROF. (SHRIMATI) BHARATI
RAY: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the cost of laying one
kilometer of rail line in India, as compared
to other countries; and
(b) how many kilometers of overaged
rail lines need immediate replacement and
the cost involved therein?
Trafficking of children
*184. DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI AIMADUDDIN
AHMED KHAN (DURRU):
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that trafficking in

Welfare Schemes for fruit and
vegetable growers in Punjab
†*185. SHRIMATI GURCHARAN
KAUR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
scheme for the welfare of vegetable and fruit
producers in Punjab;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
amount allocated for the purpose during
2001-2002; and
(c)  the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government in this regard?
Education under Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan
†*186. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have allocated
funds to various States for Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan;
(b)  if so, the amount allocated for each
State during 2001-2002; and
(c)  what amount has been released to
States by the end of December, 2000, out
of this allocated amount?
Declining standard of teaching in KVs
*187. SHRI GAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether lowering of academic/
educational standards has been registered
in the recent past, in respect of teaching in
Kendriya Vidyalayas;
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c)  the details of steps taken/
contemplated to remedy the situation?
Catering in Rajdhani and Shatabdi
Express trains
†*188. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that passengers
are being cheated even in Rajdhani and
Shatabdi Express trains, in respect of
catering; and
(b)  if so, the agency involved in such
acts of cheating and the action taken by
Government against the guilty?
Safety measures in Railways
*189. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAMACHANDRAIAH: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry of Railways
has accorded top priority to passengers’
safety;
(b)  if so, whether Rs. 2000 crore have
been spent during the current fiscal year
for the purpose;

(d)  if so, details of the amount that has
been utilized so far, for passengers safety?

Integrating production and marketing
of farm produce
1319. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in a recent
report, it was stated that there was an urgent
need to integrate production and marketing
of farm produce through a process of
reforms, to enhance price and quality
competitiveness of agricultural products;
(b) whether some of the points
mentioned are qualitative improvement by
the use of better seeds and irrigation,
infrastructure and prevention of wastage;
and
(c) if so, what are Government plans in
this regard?
Wheat to Afghanistan
1320. SHRIMATI JAYAPRADA
NAHATA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of wheat sent to
Afghanistan;
(b) what is the quantity of wheat yet to
be sent; and
(c) whether Indian council of
Agricultural Research has declared that
Indian wheat sent to Afghanistan was not
infected, as alleged by Pakistan?
Livestock population vis-a-vis fodder
availability
1321. PROF. (SHRIMATI) BHARATI
RAY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) what is the population of livestock
in the country, State-wise, and per capita
availability of fodder; and
(b) the growth rate of livestock and
fodder?
Funds to ICAR for agricultural
research
1322. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Council of
Agricultural Research has sought more
funds from Government for agricultural
research and teaching;
(b) if so, the details of funds required
and the reasons therefor;

292
WIN2\SESSION\5439RS1 292
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) how for the shortage of funds has
adversely affected agricultural production,
State-wise; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to release the necessary funds,
State-wise?
Agricultural production in U.P.
1323. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of centrally sponsored
programmes formulated and being
implemented by Government for Uttar
Pradesh to increase agricultural production
during the year 2001-2002;
(b) whether Government have fixed any
target for increasing the agricultural
production;
(c) if so, the details of achievements
made in this respect; and
(d) the details of financial assistance
provided to Uttar Pradesh for the purpose,
during the same period?
Cultivable land in Chhattisgarh
and MP
†1324. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the total area of cultivable land in
Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh;
(b) the details of increase and decrease
in cultivable land during last three years;
(c) the reasons for increase or decrease
in the agricultural land; and
(d) the details of action being taken to
overcome the decrease in cultivable land, in
view of the fast growing populat ion?
Availability of Sunflower seeds
1325. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
great demand for Sunflower oil in the
market;
(b) whether it is also a fact that farmers
are facing huge problems for non-availablity
of Sunflower seeds due to which they are
not in a position to grow Sunflower seeds,
to supply in the market; and
(c) if so, what are the proposals with
Government to increase the production of
Sunflower seeds, to meet the demand of
the agriculturists, who are producing
Sunflower seeds?
Falling prices of agricultural products
in Karnataka
1326. SHRI K.C. KONDAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that due to globalization and
WTO conditionalities, the prices of many
agricultural products were collapsing in
Karnataka; and
(b) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to protect the interests of
farmers of that State, to minimise the
negative effects of WTO conditionalities
on farmers?
Growth of agriculture sector
1327. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
recommendation of the Working Group of
the Planning Commission, an investment

would be needed during the Tenth Five Year
Plan, to achieve planned growth of 4 per
cent;
(b) whether bank policy would be
amended to provide adequate credit to
farmers, to achieve this target; and
(c) if so, what action Government are
taking in this regard?

disasters
